mn66:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo.
mn66:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn66:2.2: āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yenaññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn66:2.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn66:3.1: āyasmāpi kho udāyī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn66:3.2: āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena so vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn66:3.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn66:3.4: atha kho āyasmato udāyissa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
mn66:4.1: ‘bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā,
mn66:4.2: bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā’ti.
mn66:5.1: atha kho āyasmā udāyī sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānāvuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
mn66:6.1: “idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
mn66:6.4: mayaṃ hi bhante pubbe sāyañceva bhuñjāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle.
mn66:6.5: ahu kho so bhante samayo yaṃ bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn66:6.7: tassa mayhaṃ bhante ahudeva aññathattaṃ ahu domanassaṃ.
mn66:6.8: yampi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ denti. tassapi no bhagavā pahānamāha. tassapi no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti.
mn66:6.9: te mayaṃ bhante bhagavati pemañca gāravañca hiriñca ottappañca sampassamānā evaṃ taṃ divāvikālabhojanaṃ pajahimhā.
mn66:6.10: te mayā bhante sāyañceva bhuñjāma pāto ca.
mn66:6.11: ahu kho so bhante samayo yaṃ bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn66:6.12: iṅgha tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ rattiṃ vikālabhojanaṃ pajahathā’ti.
mn66:6.13: tassa mayhaṃ bhante ahudeva aññathattaṃ. ahu domanassaṃ
mn66:6.14: yampi no imesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhattānaṃ paṇītasaṅkhātataraṃ tassapi no bhagavā pahānamāha. tassapi no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti.
mn66:6.15: bhūtapubbaṃ bhante aññataro puriso divā sūpeyyaṃ labhitvā evamāha:
mn66:6.16: ‘handa ca imaṃ nikkhipatha, sāyaṃ sabbeva samaggā bhuñjissāmā’ti.
mn66:6.17: yā kāci bhante saṅkhatiyo sabbā tā rattiṃ, appā divā.
mn66:6.18: te mayaṃ bhante bhagavati pemañca gāravañca hiriñca ottappañca sampassamānā evaṃ taṃ rattiṃ vikālabhojanaṃ pajahimhā.
mn66:6.19: bhūtapubbaṃ bhante bhikkhū rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ piṇḍāya carantā candanikampi pavisanti. oligallepi papatanti. kaṇṭakāvaṭṭampi ārohanti, suttampi gāviṃ ārohantiṃ māṇavehipi samāgacchanti katakammehipi akatakammehipi. mātugāmopi te asaddhammena nimanteti.
mn66:6.21: addasā kho maṃ bhante aññatarā itthī vijjantarikāya bhājanaṃ dhovantī.
mn66:6.24: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante taṃ itthiṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn66:6.28: varante bhikkhu tiṇhena govikantanena kucchi parikanto natveva yaṃ rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ kucchihetu piṇḍāya carasīti.
mn66:6.29: tassa mayhaṃ bhante tadanussarato evaṃ hoti:
mn66:6.30: ‘bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā,
mn66:6.31: bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā. bahunnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā’ti.
mn66:7.1: evameva panudāyi idhekacce moghapurisā: ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu:
mn66:7.3: te tañceva nappajahanti. mayi ca appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
mn66:7.4: ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā, tesaṃ taṃ udāyi hoti balavaṃ bandhanaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ thiraṃ bandhanaṃ apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ thūllo kaliṅgaro.
mn66:8.1: seyyathāpi udāyi laṭukikā sakuṇikā pūtilatāya bandhanena baddhā tattheva vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā āgameti.
mn66:8.2: yo nu kho udāyi evaṃ vadeyya:
mn66:8.3: ‘yena sā laṭukikā sakuṇikā pūtilatāya bandhanena baddhā tattheva vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā āgameti, taṃ hi tassā abalaṃ bandhanaṃ dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhana’nti.
mn66:8.4: sammānu kho so udāyi vadamāno vadeyyā’ti.

mn66:8.7: evameva kho udāyi idhekacce moghapurisā: ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu:
mn66:8.8: kiṃ panimassa appamattakassa oramattakassa adhisallikhatevāyaṃ samaṇo’ti.
mn66:8.9: te tañceva nappajahanti, mayi ca appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.

mn66:9.4: ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā. te taṃ pahāya appossukkā pannalomā paradavuttā migabhūtena cetasā viharanti.

mn66:23.2: idampi kho ahaṃ udāyi iñjitasmiṃ vadāmi.
mn66:23.4: yadeva tattha pītisukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti, idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
mn66:24.1: idhudāyi bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
mn66:24.2: idampi kho ahaṃ udāyi iñjitasmiṃ vadāmi.
mn66:24.4: yadeva tattha upekkhāsukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti. idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
